common.noPermissionBody: Your role can't see this. Ask the owner or manager to enable it.
common.planLockedTitle: Your plan doesn't include this feature
common.planLockedBody: Available on the Advanced and Professional plans. You can change plans from Subscription.

caja.title: Cash register
caja.subtitle: Shift, tickets and closing count.
caja.noSessionBody: Open a shift with your starting cash to begin charging.
caja.expectedCashHint: Starting cash + cash tickets (includes cash tips).
caja.cashTipsHint: They're in the drawer; they belong to the barbers.
caja.ticketsEmpty: No tickets in this shift yet.
caja.cancelTicketBody: Product stock will be returned, the commission removed and the ticket will no longer count in the closing. This cannot be undone.
caja.changeMethodBody: For when one method was selected and they paid with another. Only while the shift is open; who changed it and when is recorded, and the count by method is recalculated. After the cash count, it can only be cancelled.
caja.historyDetailClosed: Closed shift: tickets can only be viewed and reprinted here.
caja.noCashManage: Your role can view the register but can't charge or close shifts.
caja.cancelMembershipBody: This ticket is a membership sale or renewal. Cancelling it cancels the membership (or puts it back as it was before the renewal) and the ticket stops counting in the cash count. This cannot be undone.
caja.cancelDepositBody: This ticket is the deposit for an appointment. Cancelling it leaves the appointment without a deposit and the ticket stops counting in the cash count. This cannot be undone.
caja.cancelRefundBody: This ticket is a deposit refund. Cancelling it undoes the refund: the deposit goes back to paid and the money counts in the cash count again. This cannot be undone.

session.openBody: Count the cash you start with. That will be the shift's starting cash.
session.openingRequired: Type how much is in the drawer. If you start with no cash, type 0.
session.amountInvalid: Type just the number: 200 or 200.50 (no signs or letters).
session.closeBody: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it. It should hold what was there at opening plus what was charged in cash.

draftsPending.one: 1 note is still to be charged.
draftsPending.other: {count} notes are still to be charged.

session.draftsPendingHint: They don't count in this cash count; charge or discard them when it's time.

apptsPending.one: 1 finished appointment has not been charged.
apptsPending.other: {count} finished appointments have not been charged.

session.apptsPendingHint: If they already paid, charge them before closing so the cash adds up.
session.countedRequired: Type what you counted in the drawer to close. If there is nothing, type 0.
session.closeWarning: A closed shift can't be reopened. To fix something later, open a new shift and leave a note.
session.cashChargedTips: Includes {tips} in tips: already counted here, do not add them again.
session.outsideDrawer: Not in the drawer (do not count it):
session.expectedHowFull: Float + cash charged + cash in − cash expenses, withdrawals, payouts and refunds.
session.openingSuggested: This is the float left at the last close ({amount}). Change it if it's not what's there.
session.openDiffShort: The last close left a float of {left} and you're opening with {amount}: {diff} short. If that's right, press again; it's noted in the close.
session.openDiffOver: The last close left a float of {left} and you're opening with {amount}: {diff} over. If that's right, press again; it's noted in the close.

ticket.title: Charge
ticket.barberOneHint: If two barbers worked on it, make one ticket per barber.
ticket.newClientSave: Save and use on this ticket
ticket.newClientForbidden: Your role can’t add clients. Charge without a client or ask the front desk to register them.
ticket.membershipNext: next period already paid from {date} (its haircuts can be used once it starts)
ticket.noProductsInPlan: Products are sold from the Advanced plan.
ticket.noProductsYet: No products yet. Add them in Business → Products.
ticket.empty: Add at least one service or product.
ticket.discountPctHint: In % it is taken from what is left on the ticket (0.01 to 100).
ticket.discountMode: Discount in pesos or as a percentage
ticket.discountInvalid: Type just the number: 50 or 50.50. For a percentage choose %.
ticket.discountCapped: It is more than what is being charged: the ticket goes to $0.
ticket.discountPctApplied: {amount} off. Recorded as a negative line.
ticket.tipHint: The tip goes entirely to the barber and never enters their commission.
ticket.tipNeedsBarber: Pick a barber to record a tip.
ticket.errorStock: Not enough stock for a product. Adjust the quantity.
ticket.depositNotice: This appointment has a paid deposit of {amount}. It is taken off the total automatically.
ticket.depositRest: The deposit is larger than what is left to charge: {amount} is not taken off on this ticket.
ticket.loyaltyRedeemEffect: “{service}” is free on this ticket. This shop's reward is “{reward}”.

print.shareText: Your ticket from {shop}: total {total}. Thanks for your visit!
print.receiptSalaryNote: Fixed salary: paid through payroll, outside this receipt.
print.receiptPartial: Partly paid on {date}; some is pending
print.receiptCoveredNote: Includes cuts covered by membership or loyalty: the client paid $0 on that ticket and commission is worked out on the service's normal price.

comisiones.title: Commissions
comisiones.subtitle: What each barber produced, what has already been paid and what is still owed, per period.
comisiones.selfOnly: You're seeing only your own commissions.
comisiones.policyHint: Tips never go into the base. The % applies to each ticket's subtotal. A cut covered by a membership or free through loyalty earns commission on the service's normal price.
comisiones.empty: No barbers with activity in this period.
comisiones.markPaidBody: You are about to mark what is pending for {name} in {period} as paid. It is recorded with the date and those tickets will no longer show under "To pay".
comisiones.markOwedTitle: Record that they paid the rent
comisiones.markOwedBody: {name} owes you {amount} for {period}: the chair rent is higher than what they produced plus their tips. Confirm only once they have paid you; it is recorded with the date and those tickets won’t show up again.
comisiones.salaryNote: Fixed salary: only tips are settled here.
comisiones.salaryApproxHint: The month isn't an exact number of weeks: it was prorated by days.
comisiones.salaryPaidNote: Salary for this period already paid: {amount}.
comisiones.salaryNoteWithAmount: Salary {salary}: the period's salary and tips are settled here.
comisiones.rentNegative: What is pending is less than the chair rent: the barber owes the difference.
comisiones.noBarberLinked: Your user isn't linked to a barber. Ask the owner to link it.
comisiones.kpiToPayBarbersHint: Pending commission and tips. Already paid this period: {paid}
comisiones.kpiRentOwedHint: Chair rent that those barbers' pending pay doesn't cover.
comisiones.kpiRentYouOweHint: Chair rent that your pending pay doesn't cover.
comisiones.toPayExplain: "To pay" is only what is pending: unpaid commission + tips from unpaid tickets − chair rent if it has not been deducted yet. What is already paid is shown separately and is not added again.
comisiones.rentAlreadyDiscounted: This period's chair rent was already deducted in an earlier payment: it is not subtracted again.
comisiones.nothingToPay: There was nothing pending to pay.
comisiones.entryCovered: Covered by membership or loyalty: commission on the normal price
comisiones.fromCash: Paid in cash from the register ({amount})
comisiones.fromCashHint: It's recorded as a barber payout in the open register and lowers what should be in the drawer. One record: don't add it again in the register.
comisiones.fromCashNoSession: No register is open: open it to pay from the drawer.

productos.title: Products
productos.subtitle: Catalog, stock and what sells most at the counter.
productos.readOnly: Here you see the products and how many are left. They are sold in the Cash register, on the same ticket as the haircut. The owner or manager adds them and sets prices and costs.
productos.lowStockBody: Products at or below their minimum. Record an entry when you restock.
productos.empty: No products yet. Add the first one.
productos.emptyTitle: Add what you sell at the counter
productos.emptyBody: Wax, pomade, beard oil, shampoo, creams… Each product has its price and how many you have. Then you charge it in the Cash register, on the same ticket as the haircut, and the stock goes down on its own.
productos.emptyReadOnly: No products have been added yet. The owner or manager adds them here; then they are charged in the Cash register.
productos.freeAsk: Is it free? The price is $0: this product will be handed out without charging. If that is right, press “Yes, it is free”.
productos.costAbovePrice: Heads up: the cost is higher than the selling price, you would sell at a loss.
productos.errPrice: Enter the price (up to 2 decimals). If it is free, enter 0.
productos.errCost: Cost must be a valid amount (up to 2 decimals) or left empty.
productos.freeBody: The price is $0: the client will pay nothing for this product and the register will charge zero.
productos.stockHint: Stock isn't edited here: record a movement instead.
productos.movementAdjustHint: Enter the real counted stock; the system records the difference.
productos.movementInHint: How many pieces come in (positive number): they are added to the stock.
productos.movementOutHint: How many pieces go out (positive number): they are taken off the stock.
productos.onWebHint: Shown on your website and in your online store.
productos.shareText: {name} — {price} at {shop}. Reserve it here and pay when you pick it up: {url}
productos.nowHidden: No longer shown on your page
productos.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate “{name}”? It stops selling at the register and disappears from your page. You can reactivate it with “Show retired”.

storeHidden.title: Your store doesn’t show on your page
storeHidden.noProducts: Turn on “Show on my page” for the products you want to sell (in each one’s “Edit” or its menu).
storeHidden.sectionOff: The “Store” section is off in My website: your clients don’t see your products or “Store” in the menu.
storeHidden.goToWeb: Turn it on in My website

productos.storeSqlPending: Photo, category and the online store turn on once the database update (sql/barber_tienda.sql) is applied. Everything else works as usual meanwhile.
productos.search: Search by name, SKU or category
productos.photoTooBig: That photo is still too large after resizing (4 MB max). Try another one.
productos.photoUnreadable: We couldn't read that image. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
productos.photoHint: It's resized automatically before upload. Shown in your store and when sharing the link.
productos.fShowOnWebHint: Appears in your online store with a link to share.
productos.fOnlineOrderHint: Customers reserve it with their name and phone, and pay at pickup.

pedidos.title: Store orders
pedidos.sqlPending: Online orders turn on once the database update (sql/barber_tienda.sql) is applied.
pedidos.waReady: Hi {name}, your order {folio} is ready for pickup at {shop}. Total: {total}.
pedidos.waReceived: Hi {name}, we got your order {folio} at {shop}. We'll let you know when it's ready.
pedidos.mpConnected: Online payment with Mercado Pago connected {account}
pedidos.mpNotConnected: Online payment: Mercado Pago isn't connected; customers pay at pickup.
pedidos.readOnly: You can see orders; whoever charges at the register hands them over.
pedidos.loadError: We couldn't load the orders. Try again.
pedidos.emptyBody: When a customer reserves a product from your online store, it shows up here with its order number.
pedidos.noSession: You need an open register shift to hand over and charge.
pedidos.deliverPaidBody: This order was already paid online ({total}). It isn't charged again: the sale is recorded in the Register as “Online payment” (not counted in the shift's cash) and stock goes down.
pedidos.refundWarning: This order was paid online ({total}). Cancelling it here does NOT refund the money: you issue the refund in Mercado Pago.
pedidos.refundDone: I already refunded it in Mercado Pago
pedidos.cancelBody: The reserved items become available again in your store.

status.staleTitle: This register has been open since {date}.
status.staleBody: Close it and count the cash first: whatever you charge today would mix into that day's close.

cards.expectedHint: Cash that should be in the drawer right now.

body.EXPENSE: What you buy or pay for the shop: blades, water, rent. Only the amount is required.
body.WITHDRAWAL: Cash leaving the drawer that isn't an expense: to the bank, to the owner.
body.DEPOSIT: Cash entering the drawer that isn't a sale: change, coins, a loan from the owner.
body.BARBER_PAYOUT: An advance is deducted later in Commissions.

mov.savedOutside: Saved outside the register: no register was open.

amountError.format: Numbers only, e.g. 80 or 80.50 (no letters or minus sign).
amountError.zero: The amount must be more than $0.

mov.outsideWarning: No register is open: this expense is saved outside the register and won't be in any close.
mov.notDrawer: Doesn't leave the drawer: doesn't change what should be in it.
mov.noBarbers: No active barbers at this location.
mov.voidBody: It isn't deleted: it stays crossed out, with who voided it and when, and stops counting in the close.
mov.voidLinkedBody: Undoes the payment marked in Commissions: the commission goes back to pending, the advances it deducted are deducted again and this entry stays crossed out. A payment that included salary can't be undone.

corte.title: Register close
corte.sign: Signature of who hands over and receives
corte.closedElsewhere: This register was already closed elsewhere. Refresh to see the close.
corte.alreadyClosed: {name} already closed this register ({time}). This is that close; it wasn't closed twice.
corte.howCount: How do you count the cash?
corte.leftQuestion: How much float do you leave for tomorrow?
corte.leftHint: What stays in the drawer to open tomorrow. It's suggested when opening.
corte.leftTooBig: You can't leave more than you counted.
corte.leftSummary: {left} left as float for tomorrow; {take} taken out.
corte.leftAll: All counted cash stays as tomorrow's float. Taking cash out when closing requires the «Take cash out and pay barbers» permission.

payc.pickBarber: Pick the barber to see what they're owed.
payc.body: Pays EVERYTHING pending for {period}, same as «Mark paid» in Commissions (one record).
payc.nothing: Nothing pending to pay this period.
payc.needsOpen: To pay in cash from the drawer, open the register first.
